SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
  AND t.profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
  AND i.symbol = '$symbol'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: $symbol - share price and move over the selected sessions
panels.description:
How $symbol stands and how far it has moved over the sessions picked in the Session box (every session in the time range unless you pick some). The whole header follows that box.

**Share price** is the close of the newest minute in the sessions picked: during market hours the minute still forming, updated at every poll of the live monitor; after the close, the session's last minute. **As of**, beside it, is when it was read.

**Difference from close** is the change since the **previous close** in rupees, then in percent, red for a fall and green for a rise, as Groww shows it. The previous close is the close of the session before the first one picked, found as for the chart's dotted *Previous close* line. NSE's official closing price is an average of the last 30 minutes, so Groww's figure can differ from this one by a little. When there is none (the first session stored for the symbol, or that session missing for it) the difference is measured from the open of the first session picked, and the tile says *(open)*: no close from days earlier stands in.

**Difference from bought** is what $symbol's shares still unsold are worth at the share price: of the buys in the newest session picked (today, by default), what has not been sold since (the journal's lots say how much of each buy has gone, the earliest buys first), its quantity times how far the price is from what was paid, added up, in rupees and then as a percent of the money laid out. Red when under water, green when up. It is before charges, and it is 0.00 when nothing is unsold, whether you bought nothing or sold it all.

**Today's gain/loss** is what $symbol has made today: the gain or loss on every one of its shares sold so far today, before charges (the lots its sells closed, so the tiles of the stocks you traded add up to the day's gross P&L on the Account Overview). It moves when a sell is imported (every minute while the market is open), is 0.00 before the stock's first sale today, and is today's whatever sessions the page shows. Red for a loss, green for a gain.

**Range** is the number of market days from the first session picked to the last, and their dates: 1D for one session, 5D for a week, as Groww's 1W or 1M. Sessions in between that are not picked do not change the difference, since it compares two prices.

A symbol with no minute data in the sessions picked shows dashes.

Beside them: **Previous close** is the close the difference is measured from; **Open** is the open of the first session picked; **High**, **Low** and **Volume** cover every minute of the sessions picked; **vs VWAP** is how far the price is above or below their volume-weighted average price (for one session, the purple line on the chart); **As of** is when the newest price was read.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH
-- Every minute of this symbol in the sessions picked, live or settled.
picked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT session_date, ts_epoch, open, high, low, close, volume
  FROM v_intraday_merged
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
span AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT MIN(session_date) AS first_day, MAX(session_date) AS last_day,
         MIN(ts_epoch) AS first_ts, MAX(ts_epoch) AS last_ts,
         MAX(high) AS high, MIN(low) AS low, SUM(volume) AS volume,
         -- The chart's VWAP formula (typical price weighted by volume), pooled over every minute picked.
         SUM((high + low + close) / 3.0 * volume) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0) AS vwap
  FROM picked
),
-- The session before the first one picked: the latest stored for any symbol, as for the chart's "Previous close" line.
before AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (SELECT MAX(p.session_date) FROM trading_day p WHERE p.session_date < (SELECT first_day FROM span)) AS day
),
-- What the difference is measured from: that session's close for this symbol, so a hole in its history never brings in
-- a close from days earlier. Without it (the first session stored for the symbol, or a hole) the first session's open.
start AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.close, o.open) AS price, c.close IS NULL AS is_open
  FROM (SELECT open FROM picked WHERE ts_epoch = (SELECT first_ts FROM span)) o
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.close FROM trading_day t JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
              WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND t.session_date = (SELECT day FROM before)
              ORDER BY t.interval_minutes LIMIT 1) c ON 1 = 1
),
figures AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.first_day, x.last_day, x.high, x.low, x.volume,
         e.close AS price, o.open AS open, s.price AS start, s.is_open,
         e.close - s.price AS change,
         CASE WHEN s.price > 0 THEN (e.close - s.price) / s.price * 100.0 END AS change_pct,
         CASE WHEN x.vwap > 0 THEN (e.close - x.vwap) / x.vwap * 100.0 END AS vs_vwap,
         -- Market days the range covers: every one from the first picked to the last, picked or not.
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT session_date FROM picked
                                UNION
                                SELECT session_date FROM trading_day WHERE session_date BETWEEN x.first_day AND x.last_day
                                UNION
                                SELECT session_date FROM live_candle WHERE session_date BETWEEN x.first_day AND x.last_day))
           AS days,
         -- When the newest price was read: the last poll, while its session is still in staging; once the evening batch
         -- has settled it, the end of its last minute.
         COALESCE((SELECT MAX(lc.updated_at) FROM live_candle lc JOIN instrument i ON i.id = lc.instrument_id
                    WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND lc.session_date = x.last_day),
                  x.last_ts + 60) * 1000 AS as_of
  FROM span x
  JOIN picked e ON e.ts_epoch = x.last_ts
  JOIN picked o ON o.ts_epoch = x.first_ts
  CROSS JOIN start s
),
-- What the shares of this symbol bought in that newest session and still unsold are worth at the share price. The
-- journal's own lots say how much of each buy has been sold (the first buys go first), so a buy sold out counts for
-- nothing and one half sold counts what is left, at its own price. Before charges; zero when nothing is unsold.
bought AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.quantity - COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS unsold, t.price AS paid
  FROM trade t
  JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
  LEFT JOIN realized_lot l ON l.buy_trade_id = t.id
  WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND t.side = 'BUY' AND t.session_date = (SELECT last_day FROM figures)
    AND t.profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY t.id
),
payout AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.unsold * (f.price - b.paid)), 0) AS payout,
         CASE WHEN SUM(b.unsold * b.paid) > 0
              THEN SUM(b.unsold * (f.price - b.paid)) / SUM(b.unsold * b.paid) * 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS payout_pct
  FROM figures f LEFT JOIN bought b ON b.unsold > 0
),
-- Gains and losses realized today on this symbol: the lots its sells closed today, before charges, as the other
-- gains here are (the stock's share of the day's gross P&L of the Account Overview). Today is by the market's clock,
-- whatever sessions the page is showing.
today AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.gross_pnl), 0) AS gain
  FROM realized_lot l
  JOIN trade t ON t.id = l.sell_trade_id
  JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
  WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND t.profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
    AND date(l.closed_ts, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') = date('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
),
-- Amounts are written out the Indian way Groww and Kite show them (1,311.50; 1,23,456.00), because Grafana's units
-- either drop the thousands commas or the trailing zero. Rounded to the paisa first, so the sign is that of the figure
-- shown: a change of -0.004 reads 0.00, not -0.00.
amounts(k, paise) AS (
  SELECT 'price',  CAST(round(price * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'change', CAST(round(change * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'start',  CAST(round(start * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'open',   CAST(round(open * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'high',   CAST(round(high * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'low',    CAST(round(low * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'volume', volume * 100 FROM figures UNION ALL
  SELECT 'payout', CAST(round(payout * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM payout UNION ALL
  SELECT 'today',  CAST(round(gain * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM today
),
rupees AS (
  SELECT k, paise, CAST(abs(paise) / 100 AS TEXT) AS r FROM amounts WHERE paise IS NOT NULL
),
-- The last three digits, then pairs: the part above the thousands is padded to ten places and cut into five pairs,
-- and the padding's empty pairs trimmed off.
written AS (
  SELECT k,
         CASE WHEN paise > 0 THEN '+' WHEN paise < 0 THEN '-' ELSE '' END AS sign,
         CASE WHEN length(r) <= 3 THEN r
              ELSE ltrim(substr(printf('%10s', substr(r, 1, length(r) - 3)), 1, 2) || ','
                      || substr(printf('%10s', substr(r, 1, length(r) - 3)), 3, 2) || ','
                      || substr(printf('%10s', substr(r, 1, length(r) - 3)), 5, 2) || ','
                      || substr(printf('%10s', substr(r, 1, length(r) - 3)), 7, 2) || ','
                      || substr(printf('%10s', substr(r, 1, length(r) - 3)), 9, 2), ' ,')
                   || ',' || substr(r, -3)
         END AS whole,
         '.' || printf('%02d', abs(paise) % 100) AS fraction
  FROM rupees
),
-- '3 Nov', with the year as well ('29 Dec 25') when the sessions picked run into another year. Non-breaking spaces
-- (char(160)) inside each date and after the arrow, so a narrow tile breaks a line before the arrow, never inside a date.
labels AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         CAST(strftime('%d', first_day) AS INTEGER) || char(160)
           || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', strftime('%m', first_day) * 3 - 2, 3)
           || CASE WHEN substr(first_day, 1, 4) <> substr(last_day, 1, 4) THEN char(160) || substr(first_day, 3, 2) ELSE '' END
           AS first_name,
         CAST(strftime('%d', last_day) AS INTEGER) || char(160)
           || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', strftime('%m', last_day) * 3 - 2, 3)
           || CASE WHEN substr(first_day, 1, 4) <> substr(last_day, 1, 4) THEN char(160) || substr(last_day, 3, 2) ELSE '' END
           AS last_name
  FROM figures f
)
SELECT (SELECT '₹' || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'price')                          AS "Share price",
       (SELECT sign || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'change')
         || ' (' || printf('%.2f', abs(change_pct)) || '%)'                                       AS "Difference from close",
       (SELECT sign || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'payout')
         || ' (' || printf('%.2f', abs((SELECT payout_pct FROM payout))) || '%)'                  AS "Difference from bought",
       (SELECT sign || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'today')                          AS "Today's gain/loss",
       days || 'D · ' || CASE WHEN first_day = last_day THEN first_name ELSE first_name || ' →' || char(160) || last_name END
                                                                                                  AS "Range",
       (SELECT '₹' || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'start') || CASE WHEN is_open THEN ' (open)' ELSE '' END
                                                                                                  AS "Previous close",
       (SELECT '₹' || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'open')                           AS "Open",
       (SELECT '₹' || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'high')                           AS "High",
       (SELECT '₹' || whole || fraction FROM written WHERE k = 'low')                            AS "Low",
       (SELECT whole FROM written WHERE k = 'volume')                                             AS "Volume",
       vs_vwap                                                                                    AS "vs VWAP",
       as_of                                                                                      AS "As of"
FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) AS base LEFT JOIN labels ON 1 = 1

FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) AS base LEFT JOIN labels ON 1 = 1

panels.description:
One-minute candles at their real timestamps. Select a single session for an uninterrupted day; several sessions leave a gap where the market was shut.

**The close.** Since 3 Aug 2026 NSE runs a closing auction for F&O stocks: they stop trading at 15:15 and print once more, at the close (15:28 or 15:29). So they have no candles between 15:15 and that last one; it is drawn at its own minute and its volume is the auction's. Stocks outside F&O trade on to 15:29.

- **VWAP** (purple) — the day's average price, weighted by the volume traded at each price. The institutional "fair price" benchmark: above it buyers have had control today, below it sellers.
- **SMA 10m / 60m** (yellow, blue) — simple moving averages of the last 10 and 60 one-minute closes. The fast line turns with a move; the slow one says whether that move is with or against the hour.
- **CPR levels** (TC, Pivot and BC, dashed blue) — the central pivot range, worked out from the High, Low and Close of the session before: Pivot = (High + Low + Close) / 3, BC = (High + Low) / 2, TC = (Pivot − BC) + Pivot. When that close was in the lower half of the day's range, TC falls below BC: the two simply swap places. As with the previous close, each session has its own flat lines, and there are none where the session before is missing. The **CPR levels** box at the top adds the supports and resistances around them, out to R1/S1, R2/S2, R3/S3 or R4/S4 (green and red; R1 = 2 × Pivot − Low, R2 = Pivot + (High − Low), R3 = R1 + (High − Low), R4 = R3 + (R2 − R1); S1 = 2 × Pivot − High, S2 = Pivot − (High − Low), S3 = S1 − (High − Low), S4 = S3 − (S1 − S2)), or switches these levels off. A support or resistance is drawn only on a session whose price reached it, between its highest high and lowest low, so none ever stretches the chart; today's appear as the price gets to them. They start off all the same, to leave the chart to the previous close and the central pivots.
- **Next day TC / Pivot / BC** (orange dashes) — tomorrow's central pivots, worked out on the fly from the newest session drawn: its highest high, lowest low and latest close so far. Today they move with the market; once the session is over they are final, and they are the lines the next session draws as its own. They stay within the session's own range, so they never stretch the chart. They are drawn only when the **Predicted CPR** box at the top is On; it starts Off, and the CPR levels box does not govern it.
- **Window entry / exit** (green, red) — the best gain window the detector found. All three windows when a single session is selected.
- **Your buy / sell** (blue, orange dots) — your own fills.
- **Previous close** (dotted) — the last session's closing value, the price today's move is measured from. With several sessions selected each session has its own flat line at its own previous close. It is missing for the earliest stored session, and where the previous session was never stored; the market-day daemon backfills yesterday's session when it starts if the evening batch missed it.

Both averages restart each session and appear only once their window is full, so the 60-minute line begins an hour into the day.

**Volume** (bars, right axis) — shares traded within each one-minute candle.

**Notes** (cyan dashed lines) — your own notes on the chart. Click the chart, press **Add annotation**, write the note (your sentiment, the plan), tag it with this symbol in capitals (for example `RELIANCE`) and a sentiment (`BULLISH`, `BEARISH` or `NEUTRAL`; `BUY` or `SELL` too if you like) and Save. It appears at once, here and on this symbol's other charts, and on the account views if it is tagged `BUY` or `SELL`. Hover its marker to read it. A note without the symbol tag is saved but not drawn.

**Noted calls** (light-blue buys, orange sells; dashed lines) — calls you documented with `trades note`. Hover a marker for the sentiment and your note.

WITH RECURSIVE scope AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_date) AS sessions
  FROM v_intraday_merged
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
-- One session: mark all three windows. Several: only the best of each.
depth AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM scope) = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS max_rank),
-- The close of the session before each selected one: the price the day's move is measured from. "Before" is
-- the latest session stored for any symbol, so a hole in this symbol's own history leaves a gap in the line
-- and not a close from several days back.
baseline AS (
  SELECT s.session_date, t.close AS prev_close, t.high AS prev_high, t.low AS prev_low
  FROM (SELECT session_date FROM trading_day WHERE session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
        UNION
        SELECT session_date FROM live_candle WHERE session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})) s
  LEFT JOIN trading_day t ON t.id =
         (SELECT p.id
            FROM trading_day p JOIN instrument i ON i.id = p.instrument_id
           WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
             AND p.session_date = (SELECT MAX(q.session_date) FROM trading_day q WHERE q.session_date < s.session_date)
           ORDER BY p.interval_minutes LIMIT 1)
),
-- The CPR (central pivot range) levels of each selected session, worked out from the High, Low and Close of the session
-- before it, step by step as the formulas are given. Every level is blank where that session is missing for the symbol
-- or has no high, low or close.
cpr_1 AS (
  SELECT session_date, prev_high AS high, prev_low AS low, prev_high - prev_low AS span,
         (prev_high + prev_low + prev_close) / 3.0 AS pivot,
         (prev_high + prev_low) / 2.0 AS bc
  FROM baseline
),
cpr_2 AS (
  SELECT session_date, span, pivot, bc,
         (pivot - bc) + pivot AS tc,
         2 * pivot - low AS r1, pivot + span AS r2,
         2 * pivot - high AS s1, pivot - span AS s2
  FROM cpr_1
),
cpr_3 AS (
  SELECT *, r1 + span AS r3, s1 - span AS s3
  FROM cpr_2
),
cpr AS (
  SELECT session_date, pivot, bc, tc, r1, r2, r3, r3 + (r2 - r1) AS r4, s1, s2, s3, s3 - (s1 - s2) AS s4
  FROM cpr_3
),
-- How far out from the central pivots the "CPR levels" box draws: 4 is every level, 0 the central pivots alone,
-- -1 none. Anything the box does not offer (a hand-edited address) is the central pivots, the box's own default.
cpr_depth AS (
  SELECT CASE '$cpr_levels' WHEN 'off' THEN -1 WHEN 'all' THEN 4 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS n
),
-- How many candles to draw at most: the "Max candles" box. Anything that is not a positive number (blank, text, zero,
-- negative) falls back to 200.
cap AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(${candles:sqlstring} AS INTEGER) >= 1 THEN CAST(${candles:sqlstring} AS INTEGER) ELSE 200 END AS n),
-- Every minute candle of the selected sessions, and how long after the one before it.
gaps AS (
  SELECT ts_epoch, session_date, open, high, low, close, volume, vwap, sma10, sma60,
         ts_epoch - LAG(ts_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY session_date ORDER BY ts_epoch) AS since_last
  FROM v_intraday_merged
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
-- Each selected session's own price range: the highest high and the lowest low of its minutes, and the time of its last.
-- The supports and resistances are drawn only where the price reached them, between these two, so that no line of
-- theirs is ever outside the candles and stretches the chart's price axis.
session_range AS (
  SELECT session_date, MAX(high) AS high, MIN(low) AS low, MAX(ts_epoch) AS last_ts
  FROM gaps GROUP BY session_date
),
-- Tomorrow's central pivots, worked out on the fly from the newest selected session's own prices: its highest high, its
-- lowest low and the close of its latest minute. Today they move with the market (the page reads again every minute);
-- for a session that is over they are final, and are the lines the session after it draws as its own. Only the newest
-- session drawn has them: an earlier one's are what the session after it already shows. They are drawn only while the
-- "Predicted CPR" box is On, which it is not to begin with, and whatever the "CPR levels" box says.
next_1 AS (
  SELECT r.session_date, (r.high + r.low + l.close) / 3.0 AS pivot, (r.high + r.low) / 2.0 AS bc
  FROM session_range r
  JOIN gaps l ON l.session_date = r.session_date AND l.ts_epoch = r.last_ts
  WHERE r.session_date = (SELECT MAX(session_date) FROM session_range)
),
next_cpr AS (
  SELECT session_date, pivot, bc, (pivot - bc) + pivot AS tc FROM next_1
),
-- Runs of trading: three minutes or more with no trades start a new run. F&O stocks pause like this for the closing
-- auction (since 3 Aug 2026 nothing trades after 15:15 until one print at the close, at 15:28 or 15:29), and thinly
-- traded stocks now and then during the day.
runs AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN since_last >= 240 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              OVER (PARTITION BY session_date ORDER BY ts_epoch) AS run
  FROM gaps
),
-- Each minute numbered within its run.
mins AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_date, run ORDER BY ts_epoch) - 1 AS pos
  FROM runs
),
sizes AS (SELECT session_date, run, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM mins GROUP BY session_date, run),
-- Minutes per drawn candle: the smallest width that keeps the whole selection within the cap. A candle never spans
-- two sessions or a pause, so each run is cut on its own: the close after the auction is a candle of its own at its
-- own minute, not folded into the one drawn at 15:15. With room to spare the width is 1, a candle per minute.
widths(w) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT w + 1 FROM widths WHERE w < 400),
width AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MIN(w), 400) AS w FROM widths
  WHERE (SELECT SUM((cnt + w - 1) / w) FROM sizes) <= (SELECT n FROM cap)
),
-- One row per drawn candle: where it starts and ends, and the range and volume of the minutes in it.
candles AS (
  SELECT session_date, run, pos / (SELECT w FROM width) AS slot,
         MIN(ts_epoch) AS from_ts, MAX(ts_epoch) AS to_ts,
         MAX(high) AS high, MIN(low) AS low, SUM(volume) AS volume
  FROM mins
  GROUP BY session_date, run, slot
),
-- The first candle of every session but the first one drawn. The flat levels (previous close, CPR) are blank there, so the
-- line breaks between sessions and each one is a flat segment at its own level, not a ramp up to the next.
placed AS (
  SELECT k.*, COALESCE(LAG(k.session_date) OVER (ORDER BY k.from_ts), k.session_date) = k.session_date AS joined
  FROM candles k
),
-- The marks, read once, then put on the candle whose minutes contain them (the average, if several do).
windows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT entry_ts, exit_ts, entry_price, exit_price FROM v_opportunity_markers
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND detector_version = '$detector' AND rank <= (SELECT max_rank FROM depth)
),
fills AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ts_epoch / 60 * 60 AS minute, side, price FROM v_trade_markers
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
),
entries AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(w.entry_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.entry_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
exits AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(w.exit_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.exit_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
buys AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'BUY' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
sells AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'SELL' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
)
SELECT k.from_ts AS time,
       -- The tooltip lists series in this order: the candle, then volume, the averages, the previous close, the CPR levels
       -- from R4 down to S4, tomorrow's central pivots, then your marks.
       -- A candle opens where its first minute opened and closes where its last closed; the averages are read at its end.
       f.open  AS open,
       l.close AS close,
       k.high  AS high,
       k.low   AS low,
       k.volume AS volume,
       l.vwap  AS "VWAP",
       l.sma10 AS "SMA 10m",
       l.sma60 AS "SMA 60m",
       CASE WHEN k.joined THEN base.prev_close END AS "Previous close",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 4 AND c.r4 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r4 END AS "R4",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 3 AND c.r3 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r3 END AS "R3",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 2 AND c.r2 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r2 END AS "R2",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 1 AND c.r1 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r1 END AS "R1",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.tc END AS "TC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.pivot END AS "Pivot",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.bc END AS "BC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 1 AND c.s1 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s1 END AS "S1",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 2 AND c.s2 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s2 END AS "S2",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 3 AND c.s3 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s3 END AS "S3",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 4 AND c.s4 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s4 END AS "S4",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.tc END AS "Next day TC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.pivot END AS "Next day Pivot",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.bc END AS "Next day BC",
       en.price AS "Window entry",
       ex.price AS "Window exit",
       bu.price AS "Your buy",
       se.price AS "Your sell"
FROM placed k
JOIN mins f ON f.ts_epoch = k.from_ts
JOIN mins l ON l.ts_epoch = k.to_ts
LEFT JOIN baseline base ON base.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN cpr c ON c.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN session_range sr ON sr.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN next_cpr nx ON nx.session_date = k.session_date
CROSS JOIN cpr_depth d
LEFT JOIN entries en ON en.session_date = k.session_date AND en.run = k.run AND en.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN exits   ex ON ex.session_date = k.session_date AND ex.run = k.run AND ex.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN buys    bu ON bu.session_date = k.session_date AND bu.run = k.run AND bu.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN sells   se ON se.session_date = k.session_date AND se.run = k.run AND se.slot = k.slot
ORDER BY k.from_ts

windows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT entry_ts, exit_ts, entry_price, exit_price FROM v_opportunity_markers
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND detector_version = '$detector' AND rank <= (SELECT max_rank FROM depth)
),
fills AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ts_epoch / 60 * 60 AS minute, side, price FROM v_trade_markers
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
),
entries AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(w.entry_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.entry_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
exits AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(w.exit_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.exit_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
buys AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'BUY' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
),
sells AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.run, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'SELL' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.run, k.slot
)
SELECT k.from_ts AS time,
       -- The tooltip lists series in this order: the candle, then volume, the averages, the previous close, the CPR levels
       -- from R4 down to S4, tomorrow's central pivots, then your marks.
       -- A candle opens where its first minute opened and closes where its last closed; the averages are read at its end.
       f.open  AS open,
       l.close AS close,
       k.high  AS high,
       k.low   AS low,
       k.volume AS volume,
       l.vwap  AS "VWAP",
       l.sma10 AS "SMA 10m",
       l.sma60 AS "SMA 60m",
       CASE WHEN k.joined THEN base.prev_close END AS "Previous close",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 4 AND c.r4 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r4 END AS "R4",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 3 AND c.r3 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r3 END AS "R3",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 2 AND c.r2 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r2 END AS "R2",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 1 AND c.r1 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.r1 END AS "R1",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.tc END AS "TC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.pivot END AS "Pivot",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 0 THEN c.bc END AS "BC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 1 AND c.s1 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s1 END AS "S1",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 2 AND c.s2 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s2 END AS "S2",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 3 AND c.s3 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s3 END AS "S3",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND d.n >= 4 AND c.s4 BETWEEN sr.low AND sr.high THEN c.s4 END AS "S4",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.tc END AS "Next day TC",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.pivot END AS "Next day Pivot",
       CASE WHEN k.joined AND '$cpr_next' = 'on' THEN nx.bc END AS "Next day BC",
       en.price AS "Window entry",
       ex.price AS "Window exit",
       bu.price AS "Your buy",
       se.price AS "Your sell"
FROM placed k
JOIN mins f ON f.ts_epoch = k.from_ts
JOIN mins l ON l.ts_epoch = k.to_ts
LEFT JOIN baseline base ON base.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN cpr c ON c.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN session_range sr ON sr.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN next_cpr nx ON nx.session_date = k.session_date
CROSS JOIN cpr_depth d
LEFT JOIN entries en ON en.session_date = k.session_date AND en.run = k.run AND en.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN exits   ex ON ex.session_date = k.session_date AND ex.run = k.run AND ex.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN buys    bu ON bu.session_date = k.session_date AND bu.run = k.run AND bu.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN sells   se ON se.session_date = k.session_date AND se.run = k.run AND se.slot = k.slot
ORDER BY k.from_ts

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sessions AS (
  -- Minute-derived sessions where there are some; the daily bar for a session that has none. This symbol only, in
  -- each branch: over the whole market's daily bars the query would take over a second.
  SELECT t.session_date AS session_date, t.first_candle_ts AS ts_epoch,
         t.open AS open, t.high AS high, t.low AS low, t.close AS close, t.volume AS volume
  FROM trading_day t JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
  WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.session_date, d.ts_epoch, d.open, d.high, d.low, d.close, d.volume
  FROM daily_bar d JOIN instrument i ON i.id = d.instrument_id
  WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_day t
                    WHERE t.instrument_id = d.instrument_id AND t.session_date = d.session_date)),
ranked AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, session_date, ts_epoch, open, high, low, close, volume,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) ORDER BY session_date)      AS first_in_week,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) ORDER BY session_date DESC) AS last_in_week
  FROM sessions),
w AS (
  SELECT week,
         MIN(session_date)                                AS session_date,
         MIN(ts_epoch)                                    AS ts_epoch,
         MAX(CASE WHEN first_in_week = 1 THEN open END)   AS open,
         MAX(high)                                        AS high,
         MIN(low)                                         AS low,
         MAX(CASE WHEN last_in_week = 1 THEN close END)   AS close,
         SUM(volume)                                      AS volume
  FROM ranked GROUP BY week)
SELECT w.ts_epoch AS time,
       w.open  AS open,
       w.high  AS high,
       w.low   AS low,
       w.close AS close,
       w.volume AS volume,
       b.price AS "Buy",
       s.price AS "Sell"
FROM w
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'BUY' AND symbol = '$symbol' AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring}) GROUP BY week) b
       ON b.week = w.week
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'SELL' AND symbol = '$symbol' AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring}) GROUP BY week) s
       ON s.week = w.week
WHERE w.session_date >= date($__from/1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes', '-6 days')
ORDER BY w.session_date

panels.description:
Always the last 6 months, whatever range the rest of the page is showing.

The **Buy** and **Sell** dots are your fills, averaged over the week the trade happened in.

Each week is built from the minute-derived sessions where the database has them, and from the daily candles for the
sessions it does not: a symbol added to the tracked list has minute history for only about three months, but its
daily candles go back a year, and a symbol outside the tracked list has only those. A day held both ways is counted
once, as the session, so what was already drawn does not move. The two agree to a few paise on the close.
